text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hup! Hah! Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, at Tracen Academy's carrot
patch...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki, Tamamo Cross, and Inari
One are
all taking part in some voluntary
farmwork.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Whew! Tending carrots is quite
backbreaking.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. It's so satisfying to help
others. It
makes for good training too.
choice_data_list: ボランティア、お疲れ様！

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I wonder how
Tamamo and
Inari are doing. I'd be more
than happy to lend
them some help...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
They should be tending that field over
there...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whew! You gotta sweat in the fields to
truly
'ppreciate how delicious your daily
rice is! How ya
holdin' up, Tama?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm doin' real good! This is easy as
turnin'
over takoyaki!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Look at you, actin' all tough! All right,
how 'bout
we have a little competition?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like a blast, count me in! Get in
on this,
Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Da first-ever "Farmin' Stakes" are about
to kick
off!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm afraid I'll have to pass.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't be a party pooper. Havin' a
lil' fun can
speed this stuff up, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This is all to help the academy. We
mustn't lose
sight of that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Farming is similar to mental training.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: How so?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It may seem like rough work at first
glance, but
farming actually involves
delicate technique. At
times, you clash
forcefully with nature, while at
others,
you tend to the crops with care.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
As you watch over the crops slowly
growing
bigger and stronger, you grow
as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You can't simply give in to your
emotions and
throw yourself into things
single-mindedly.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, now I get it! When ya put it that
way, I feel
like maybe I could get behind
that way of thinkin'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, hearin' you say that all
composed-like sure
is convincin'...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Inari! Let's take a page outta
Yaeno's book
and work like we're
trainin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I hear ya loud and clear! Farmin' is
trainin'... Hehe,
ya got me there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whew! That's most the tillin' done,
don'tcha
think?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, should be. Wanna take a li'l
break? We
can't go gettin' tunnel vision,
after all. Gotta
remember the basics of
farmin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You might wanna take a break too,
Yaeno—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Th-the heck wuzzat?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Mind focused, with full concentration!
That is true
growth! Hi-yah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clink! Scrape! Clank! Scrape!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hold a sec! Aren't you da one that said
not to
give into your emotions?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I-I guess this is a form of trainin' for her,
but
maybe we should stop her, all the
same?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Osu! I will do my best!
choice_data_list: 行けヤエノ、この勢いを止めずに！
修行に大事なのは持続すること！

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Y-ya sure she's okay goin' so hard?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I don't know... Though, the field is gettin' tilled real fast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki finishes tilling with
astonishing
speed. The work does get
done ahead of
schedule, but...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Osu! Now that's real training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Actually, if she's pleased with the
results, maybe
we ought to leave it at
that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly right! Once you start
training, you
can't abandon it partway
through!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Focus! Push! Focus! Push!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
S-so precise! I thought she was relyin' on
raw
strength, but now that I'm lookin'
real close, I can
see how meticulous she
is!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, we can't let her outdo us! Let's
go, Tama!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the three of them
continue to till
the field diligently...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, they do so well that Director
Akikawa,
who's in charge of the plot,
praises their efforts!
